verdict.rationale: smolagents' CodeAgent writes and executes arbitrary Python code (with authorized imports), which inherently supports loops/batch processing over collections of items, but the evidence pack contains no explicit example, benchmark, or documentation demonstrating bulk/batch operations across many items — this capability is only inferable from the general code-execution design rather than directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation/batch-processing examples, docs on iterating over large item sets, evidence of reliability/performance at scale.
